title: Meteor vs Black Hole vs Quake - three executions from one real Moss Grove match
text: Three executions from a single AI-vs-AI match in the Moss Grove: Aldric's quake, then the mage Osmund's meteor and his black hole (the kill that ended the match, Dawn won on count). Every mill and execution here is the engine's own; both sides are played by the game's AI. Millfall is Nine Men's Morris where every mill is an execution: 33 executions, 4 arenas, fully offline. Microsoft Store: https://apps.microsoft.com/detail/9NHQ64JTDQV2?cid=rd

title: How to play Nine Men's Morris in 90 seconds
text:
The whole game in about 90 seconds, shown on Millfall's own board: placing, moving, flying, what a mill is, and how a match ends. Every scene is a real match; both sides are played by the game's own AI.

Video: https://youtu.be/BR3qphgTVRY
